definitions: to leave a place, usually to start a journey
to remove something from something else
to have a particular relationship with someone
to send something, such as a letter or email
examples: We need to get off early tomorrow to avoid traffic.
Can you help me get this sticker off the window?
He was lucky to get off with just a warning.
I don't really get off on that kind of music.
I need to get off this email before lunch.
She really got off on the idea of a promotion.
